# Create an evaluation set — applied workshop

You support an operations analysis team. Write six expected outcomes, including two cases that must not trigger action.

## Concept setup · 10 minutes
Include ordinary, ambiguous, abstention and adversarial cases. Label expected outcomes before running the candidate. Aggregate accuracy can hide severe failures.

## Implementation · 20 minutes
Calculate reviewed count, total and review rate for each fictional queue; missing confidence requires review. Open the starter notebook or visual workflow simulator.

## Task · 20 minutes
Write six expected outcomes, including two cases that must not trigger action. Record a normal, missing-input and human-review case.

## Research and discussion · 15 minutes
Compare with a peer, cite your reading and identify a failure condition.

## Wrap-up · 5 minutes
Explain why a simulation is not a production-ready system; name the accountable owner.

## Submission
Draft cohort policy: 2–3-page APA-style paper with relevant code, output screenshots and citations. Word/PDF upload and Sunday 11:59 PM deadline need a scheduled cohort; no live deadline is set.

## Integrity
AI coaching on concepts and ungraded practice is allowed with disclosure. Graded reasoning must be your own.
